written.headline: Altimeter aims to invest $5B in Anthropic IPO
written.summary: Altimeter Capital aims to invest $5 billion in the Anthropic IPO, according to Brad Gerstner. The planned investment is five times larger than the firm's previous largest IPO investment.

written.headline: Anthropic cuts vulnerability disclosure window to 30 days for serious flaws
written.summary: Anthropic reduced its coordinated vulnerability disclosure window from 90 to 30 days for high- and critical-severity issues to adapt to AI-driven bug discovery. The new timelines apply to vulnerabilities reported on or after January 1, 2027.

written.headline: Major U.S. life insurers held $85.2B in AI debt as of June 30
written.summary: Major U.S. life insurers held $85.2 billion in AI debt as of June 30, representing a 24% increase from December 31 according to Moody's Ratings. This figure could reach $185 billion by the end of 2027 as insurers invest customer funds into artificial intelligence deals.

written.headline: Hugging Face and OpenRouter partner to run open-weight models
written.summary: Hugging Face teamed up with OpenRouter to switch its Inference Providers to OpenRouter's custom router. This lets users run open-weight models from the Hugging Face Hub using their token through OpenRouter's API routing.

written.headline: Constellation Energy raises guidance and shrugs off data center fears
written.summary: Constellation Energy reported strong third-quarter earnings and raised its full-year guidance to $12.50-$12.80, unaffected by market concerns over Democratic midterm election gains. CEO Joe Dominguez stated that the company has signed about 8,500 MW of long-term deals this year.

written.headline: FrontierML benchmark measures AI agents turning capital into performance
written.summary: Researchers developed the FrontierML benchmark to measure how well AI agents use money to improve machine learning performance. Frontier systems showed they can use additional capital to improve their performance across 21 long-horizon tasks.
